# jitguard_approval_rules (Data Source)

Lists every approval rule for the customer. Useful for discovering existing
rules before adopting them into Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jitguard_approval_rules" "all" {}

output "rule_names" {
  value = [for r in data.jitguard_approval_rules.all.rules : r.name]
}
```
